demo.cliff: the anchor a program points at
teaches: processing is the budget every program running on this machine draws its bandwidth from.
options[] is a trait list under the custom family: it is where a hardened casing or a fitted interface is recorded.
specialised {software, bonus} is the one program this machine is built around and what it is worth.
demo.trap: Nothing on either side of the link stores a name. A program says which machine it runs on by holding this document's id in software.computerId, and this document holds no list of what runs on it. A computer Item is not the only host either: an equipped armour and a fitted augment both run software when they carry a Processing figure. This Item exists twice in the pack for that reason — loose here, and embedded on the Demo — Traveller where a program can actually point at it.

system.description: A wrist unit with a cracked case and a good aerial. Runs two programs if neither is ambitious.
